messages:
maria: Quick sync - Tom (Arco) and I ran a quick perf/W sweep on redwood-small-quant. Observed a regression at seq=1024 with the new quant profile. Looks like kernel tiling difference might be the culprit.

ajay: can you share the numbers and the exact config used?

maria: baseline (old quant): 1,050 tok/s; new quant: 860 tok/s (~18% drop). power roughly same. repro config: seq=1024, bs=1, model=redwood-small-v2-quant.

lia-eng: that matches a spike in nightly P-core CPU offload we saw. tagging @tom-arco for the kernel flags used on your image.

Tom-arco: we ran Arco stock driver + our perf layer. flags:
```
PERF_LAYER=arco-tune-v3
L2_TILE=512
KV_MODE=split
QUANT_PROFILE=fast-fp16
GEMM_PATCH=true
```
The GEMM patch is a small micro-optimization we can disable.

maria: Redwood image used L2_TILE=256 and KV_MODE=combined. if L2_TILE mismatch is the root cause then aligning tile size might recover throughput. can we test L2_TILE=512 + KV_MODE=combined?

ajay: plan: run three variants today: (1) Arco flags, (2) Redwood flags, (3) mixed (Arco L2_TILE + Redwood KV). Lia, can you run and capture perf counters + power trace? aim EOD.

lia-eng: running now. will push bench script to the shared repo and link the run.

benchbot: new bench run created -> https://bench.redwood.internal/runs/6187655000-a (variants queued) :bar_chart:

lia-eng: initial run results: A(Arco)=820 tok/s, B(Redwood)=1010 tok/s, C(mixed)=995 tok/s. So Redwood defaults still best for throughput; Arco GEMM patch does lower tail latency slightly.

Tom-arco: useful signal. suggests merging L2_TILE=512 with our GEMM patch might be the sweet spot. we'll open a joint PR with a cleaned patchset (redacting any IP-sensitive internals) and mark it partner-review.

maria: proposed action items: 1) joint kernel flags PR (owner: Tom), 2) SI onboarding doc update for quant/flags (owner: Ajay), 3) canary plan for marketplace image (owner: Maria). target freeze 2 weeks from now for partner announcement. owners please ack.

ajay: ack for SI doc. I'll add acceptance KPIs: throughput delta <=5%, power delta <=3%, 95p tail latency within baseline.

Tom-arco: PR by tomorrow EOD. we'll include a compatibility matrix and note driver-only change (no FW required).

lia-eng: once PR lands I'll queue a 24h soak on Dedicated nodes and capture telemetry dashboards + perf counters.

maria: marketing requested an embargoed one-pager for the joint listing. I can draft, but we need final numbers and engineering sign-off first.

Tom-arco: understood. we'll label the PR "partner-ready" once CI + soak pass.

ajay: any blockers? do we require firmware or BIOS changes on partner boards to fully realize gains? if so, we should add that to the rollout timeline.

maria: Tom, can you confirm whether GEMM_PATCH requires FW?

Tom-arco: it's driver-only. no FW/BIOS changes needed. timeline safe.

lia-eng: logging a canary-alert doc in incidents if perf regresses during soak: https://incidents.redwood/internal/6187655000-canary. ops + bench teams subscribed.

maria: great. I'll coordinate marketplace metadata (supported profiles, recommended batch sizes, known limitations).

benchbot: recap: actions -> PR (Tom-arco), SI doc (Ajay), Canary soak (Lia), Marketing one-pager (Maria). Checkpoint in 48h. :eyes:

maria: thanks all. ping here with any failing traces or failed soaks. :pray:
